Container.Name: Aggregatarr
Container.Overview: One-pane dashboard for a home media stack: live download queue across qBittorrent and SABnzbd matched to Sonarr, Radarr, and Lidarr, a combined calendar, activity feed, health alerts, and quick actions. API keys stay on the server. The container runs as nobody:users (99:100). qBittorrent and SABnzbd behind gluetun are just their own URLs (gluetun host IP and the app port).

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Aggregatarr web interface.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, encrypted credentials, and the ASP.NET Data Protection key ring.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid convention. The image already runs as uid 99 (nobody). This variable is not read by the app.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unraid convention. The image already runs as gid 100 (users). This variable is not read by the app.
